verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same, and both have the same main flaws. The GROVE wordmark is centred but the headline and body copy are left-aligned, while the badges and CTA are pushed right, so the left edge doesn't line up. The two badges nearly touch each other, the badges sit too close under the body copy, and the badges and CTA run right up to the right edge. A is worse because its bottom group is lower and more cramped, with only about 38px below the CTA, and it has a large gap above the circle. B moves everything up, which leaves the spacing at the top and bottom slightly more even.
